ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from changing status from: - 'Equifax Failed' to either 'Daon Failed', 'ID Ops: Daon Approved', 'Confirmed Fraud' (ID Ops Assistance cases) - 'Equifax Failed' to either 'Daon Failed', 'Fraud check: Daon Approved' (Fraud Check cases)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the status from 'Equifax Failed' to either 'Daon Failed', 'ID Ops: Daon Approved', 'Fraud check: Daon Approved' or 'Confirmed Fraud'
